title: Fried Anchovies

media.caption: Dip the anchovies in the flour
Dip the anchovies in the flour
Then dip the anchovies in the egg mixture.
Then dip the anchovies in the egg mixture.
Turn the anchovies during frying to ensure even color on both sides.
Remove the fried anchovies and drain them on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Serve the fried anchovies hot, sprinkled with salt and a squeeze of lemon juice.

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil for frying

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Omega-3
healthBenefits.text: Anchovies are packed with omega-3 fatty acids that support heart health and reduce inflammation.

healthBenefits.title: High-Quality Protein
healthBenefits.text: This dish provides a substantial amount of lean protein, essential for muscle repair and growth.

healthBenefits.title: Bone Support
healthBenefits.text: Anchovies contain calcium and vitamin D, both important for maintaining strong bones.

healthBenefits.title: Brain Function
healthBenefits.text: Vitamin B12 found in anchovies supports nervous system health and cognitive function.

healthBenefits.title: Vitamin C Boost
healthBenefits.text: A squeeze of lemon juice adds vitamin C, which aids iron absorption and supports immunity.

healthBenefits.title: Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Frying in extra virgin olive oil provides monounsaturated fats beneficial for cardiovascular health.

_ingredientsText:
600 gr of large anchovies 
flour for breading 
3 eggs
salt
extra virgin olive oil for frying
juice of 1 lemon (optional)
_preparationText:
1 - 3 pulizia delle acciughe
4 - 7 preparazione della frittata
8 -10 fasi della friggitura
